citations.quote: Part (2) gives a special case where the VaR risk measure is subadditive and therefore coherent

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Spherical/elliptical laws defined via the stochastic representation X = mu + RAS and the characteristic-generator form; inside a common elliptical world VaR is subadditive and coherent and mean-variance (Markowitz) optimization is justified, marking the boundary of Gaussian-style risk intuition, per McNeil et al. (2015) Ch.6 and Ch.8.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Spherical and Elliptical Distributions: When VaR Behaves and Markowitz Holds
